{{Youmay|the Velcar Free Commerce Zone|the [[Velcar sector/Legends|Velcar sector]] or the [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|Free Trade Zone]]}}
The '''Velcar Free Commerce Zone''' ('''FCZ''') was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] located in the [[Velcar sector/Legends|Velcar sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The regions [[Commerce Master Commissioner]] represented the zone business interests to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Many primitive [[Species/Legends|species]] inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planets]], and were essentially [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] as indentured laborers to the Empire. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], FCZ was located in [[Oversector Outer]], and fell under [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], then his successor, [[Ardus Kaine]].

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Kaine held a series of [[Pentastar Talks|talks]] with the leaders of the Commerce Zone, along with neighboring political, military, and business leaders. At the end of the talks, a [[Pentastar Alignment Treaty|treaty]] was signed forming the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. The Velcar Free Commerce Zone was absorbed into the new government. The Alignment eventually collapsed and was annexed by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].
